what: The estate's decision protocol as data (spec: docs/specs/2026-10-31-decision-protocol.md). Two tables an agent consults through bin/decision-frame: LAWS (what binds, how to recognise that it applies, what it does to the decision) and METHODS (which way of deciding fits which situation, and whether the estate has it yet). It indexes the estate's laws; it does not restate them. The source of each law stays AGENTS.md or docs/training/2026-10-30-founder-judgement.md. Deciders follow ADR 0044 (machine, model, judgment).

laws.says: An agent never raises a pull request and never pushes main. Push lane/<name> and stop.
Secrets are referenced by name. Never print, paste or ask for a value.
An action goes through an intent; if no intent exists, add the capability properly, never a temporary door.
No work without a claim; changes stay inside the claim's paths; overlap means pick other work.
Prove the layer does not exist (growmos query, rg) before building; a second copy is deleted in the same change.
Every status or done claim ties to a measurement taken this run. Built is not operating.
Cloud is the default route; a capability that works only through the laptop is a fallback, not done.
Place a workload by the free-tier ladder; state CPU and memory requests for the node.
Drive to operational and proven; stop only on an irrevocable blocker reported with the intent run, exit status and printed line.
Make only the change that was asked for; record what you find on the way, do not fix it unasked.
Say machine, model or judgment before acting; judgment names its irreducibility.
Irreversible or outward-facing steps need an explicit approval; dry-run the same plan first.
A fallback serves the same contract behind the same door, or it is a second door and is deleted.
A failing gate is a report, not a repair; remove the class of failure.
Measure the goal, not the process: alive is not healthy.
An unmeasurable thing is unknown, and unknown is not a pass.
Priority is the registry's order and weights, not memory; founder-critical functions come first.
A free agent takes the head of the incident queue, not the easiest item.
An assumption is written down with the probe that would show it broke.
If the founder would measure it by hand, build the machine that does.

methods.use_when: goals have a declared order; a hard law applies; the answer must be re-derivable
methods.avoid_when: the order itself is the open question

methods.approach: value of information: take the cheapest measurement before acting
methods.impl: probes in platform/estate/libexec/critical-probe.py; bounded probe request in packages/method_selector
methods.use_when: evidence is missing or stale and a probe is cheap, reversible and inside scope
methods.avoid_when: the probe costs more than a wrong reversible guess

methods.use_when: a failure or anomaly has several candidate causes and evidence discriminates between them
the question is which way to attack a problem
methods.avoid_when: an authorisation is needed (it recommends, it never grants)

methods.approach: calibrated decision model with a confidence floor
methods.use_when: a bounded choice among named options, reversible, no deterministic rule
methods.avoid_when: irreversible, or confidence is below the floor (then escalate)

methods.approach: abstain/defer rule with a measured coverage-risk curve (selective prediction, conformal)
methods.impl: none yet; needs the decision record's outcomes to calibrate against
methods.use_when: a model decides repeatedly and outcomes are graded; the floor should be earned, not fixed
methods.avoid_when: fewer than a few hundred graded outcomes; keep the fixed floor until then

methods.use_when: a hard-to-undo or cross-cutting choice a model may make; voters must be independent
methods.avoid_when: voters share the same evidence and prompt (it is one vote repeated)

methods.approach: contextual bandit (Thompson sampling) with an exploration budget
methods.impl: none yet; candidate home is router lane choice and agent assignment
methods.use_when: the same choice recurs, reward is measured per outcome, and a bad arm is cheap
methods.avoid_when: one-off choices, delayed or unmeasured reward, irreversible arms

methods.approach: robust statistical baseline (median/MAD or control chart) on estate_health history
methods.impl: none yet; input is the heartbeat history
methods.use_when: deciding if a reading is abnormal for this series
methods.avoid_when: too little history; report BLIND, not normal

methods.approach: replay and ablation: did the intervention change the outcome
methods.use_when: judging whether a protocol, brief or lane helped
a protocol or state machine must provably never reach a state
methods.avoid_when: the property is empirical, not logical

methods.approach: human judgment through the founder decision door (one message per decision)
methods.use_when: value-tradeoff, irreversible, novel, or low-confidence escalation
methods.avoid_when: a machine or model can decide: 'I was not sure' is not an irreducibility
